Zstd decoding measurements, 2026-10-20 (Asia/Tokyo)
Apple M3; darwin/arm64; Go 1.27.0; TinyGo 0.42.0 / LLVM 22.1.4.
GOMAXPROCS=1; one benchmark at a time; 500 ms per sample; five samples.
Backend order rotated each round: host, purego, tinygo-z, tinygo-2.
All frames decode to the same 57,705 bytes and carry XXH64 checksums.
Throughput is decoded bytes in decimal MB/s; buffers and decoders warmed.
The profiles use force_tinygo_logic compiled with Go, not native TinyGo.
